# Gray Scrape

> Gray Scrape is a next-generation adaptive, anti-bot web scraper and stealth extraction engine. It features DOM auto-relocation (`adapt_css`), Cloudflare Turnstile bypass, TLSv1.3 client fingerprinting, canvas anti-fingerprint noise, and token-optimized Reader Mode output.

Website: https://gray-scrape.vercel.app
API Base Endpoint: https://gray-scrape.vercel.app/api/scrape
Search Base Endpoint: https://gray-scrape.vercel.app/api/search

## Publisher & Ownership Information

- **Created By**: Graytell Labs
- **Owner**: Anubhav Sapkota
- **Contact Email**: graytell.t@gmail.com
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/graytell
- **X (Twitter)**: https://x.com/GrayTell_Org
- **Instagram**: https://www.instagram.com/GrayTell_Org

## Key Features

- **Stealthy Fetcher**: Bypasses Cloudflare Turnstile, 503 bot barriers, and WAF challenge pages.
- **Adaptive Relocator**: Self-healing CSS locator (`adapt_css`) that tracks elements even when website HTML/classes change or mutate.
- **Reader Mode**: Extracts clean Markdown with navigation, footers, boilerplate, and ad scripts stripped out.
- **Link Separation**: Paragraph text links are padded cleanly. Optional `# Links` section appends hyperlinked citations when requested (`includeLinks: true`).
- **Media & Avatars**: Automatically extracts high-res hero images, figures, and author profile pictures.
- **CLI & Tool Calling**: Run via `npx gray-scrape <url>` or integrate into AI agents (LangChain, OpenAI Agents, Gemini, CrewAI).

## API Documentation

### Extract Webpage Content (`POST /api/scrape`)

Request headers:
- `Content-Type: application/json`

Request body schema:
```json
{
  "url": "https://openai.com/research",
  "selector": "h1, article",
  "stealthMode": true,
  "includeImages": true,
  "includeLinks": false,
  "solveCloudflare": true,
  "hideCanvas": true,
  "blockWebrtc": true,
  "googleReferrer": true,
  "blockAdsAndTrackers": true
}
```

Response JSON schema snippet:
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "statusCode": 200,
  "metadata": {
    "title": "Document Title",
    "description": "Excerpt summary",
    "wordCount": 1250,
    "readTimeMinutes": 6
  },
  "readerMode": {
    "markdown": "# Document Title\n\nClean markdown text content...",
    "contentHtml": "<div>...</div>"
  },
  "stealthFingerprint": {
    "cloudflareSolver": true,
    "canvasNoiseProtection": true,
    "tlsProfile": "TLSv1.3 (GREASE, X25519)"
  }
}
```

### Search Web Without API Keys (`GET /api/search?q=<query>`)

Response JSON snippet:
```json
{
  "query": "next generation AI agents",
  "count": 6,
  "results": [
    {
      "title": "Article Title",
      "url": "https://example.com/article",
      "snippet": "Short excerpt...",
      "points": 420
    }
  ]
}
```

## CLI Usage

```bash
# Instant extraction to Markdown
npx gray-scrape https://openai.com/research

# Save directly to file
npx gray-scrape https://openai.com/research -o openai.md

# Extract with hyperlinks section
npx gray-scrape https://openai.com/research --links

# Focused selector with JSON format
npx gray-scrape https://news.ycombinator.com -s ".titleline" -f json

# Search web without API keys
npx gray-scrape search "quantum computing"
```

## AI Agent Integration (`read_web_page` Tool)

```typescript
async function readWebPage(url: string): Promise<string> {
  const res = await fetch('https://gray-scrape.vercel.app/api/scrape', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify({ url, stealthMode: true, includeLinks: false }),
  });
  const data = await res.json();
  return data.readerMode?.markdown || '';
}
```
